chunks: And Muḥammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام:
“A menstruating woman performs the funeral prayer, but she does not stand in line with them.”

key_terms.الْجِنَازَةِ: the funeral or funeral prayer context
key_terms.مَعَهُمْ: with them, meaning with the congregation

ai.seo_question: Can a menstruating woman participate in salat al-janazah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a menstruating woman and salat al-janazah. It indicates that she may participate in the funeral prayer, while not standing in the rows together with the congregation.
